title: Analytics Analyst - Agriculture
description:
Fastmarkets is an industry‑leading price‑reporting agency (PRA) and information provider for global commodities, offering price data, news, analytics and events for agriculture, forest products, metals and mining, and new‑generation energy markets. Fastmarkets’ data is critical for customers seeking to understand and predict dynamic, sometimes opaque markets, enabling trading and risk management. With a history dating back to 1865, Fastmarkets is a global business with more than 700 employees across the UK, US, China, India, Singapore, Brazil, Belgium, Bulgaria, Finland and beyond.

The Role

The Grains Analyst is responsible for delivering market intelligence, price forecasting, and analytical insights across global corn, barley, and wheat markets. This role strengthens Fastmarkets’ grains coverage by producing timely commentary, enhancing analytical methodologies, and supporting the commercialization of our agriculture analytics products.

The analyst will play a key role in evolving our grains analytics offering, currently focused on monthly forecasting and short‑term commentary, and expanding our capabilities in line with client demand for transparent, actionable insights across feed, food, and biofuel‑linked grain markets.

The ideal candidate is interested in economic and commodity market research and will thrive in a fast‑paced and innovative environment, have a can‑do attitude, juggle various tasks and projects, and meet deadlines.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Data gathering, analysis, and forecasting
  • Producing written commentary, fundamental outlooks, data visualizations, and price forecasts
  • Building industry knowledge and contacts
  • Client contact and presentations

Qualifications

We recruit talented, dynamic people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, all united by a belief in our mission to provide the world’s leading and most trusted price reporting, events, and intelligence service for the markets we serve. We’re proud to be an equal‑opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fully inclusive workplace, where everyone feels able to participate and contribute meaningfully. If you are open‑minded, curious, resilient, solutions‑oriented and committed to promoting equality, then read on.

Knowledge, Experience and Skills

  • Understanding of global food and feed grain production regions and their trade interdependencies
  • Familiarity with how global energy policy impacts agricultural product supply and demand
  • Experience building or maintaining commodity supply/demand models, price models, and short‑term forecasting processes
  • Experience supporting commercial teams or engaging clients with insights and market outlook commentary
  • Able to critically assess statistical analyses and forecast models and suggest improvements and develop new models
  • Excellent written and verbal English

Behavioral Competencies

  • Manage deadlines across multiple forecasting cycles with strong time‑management and task‑prioritization skills
  • Willingness to learn new technological tools, new processes, or updated analytics workflows
  • Maintain attention to detail in data, commentary, and forecasting outputs
  • Communicate complex market drivers and forecasts clearly to both technical and commercial audiences
  • Ensure commentary and forecasts are actionable and relevant to traders, processors, food companies, and biofuel participants
  • Build strong relationships with colleagues in analytics, editorial, sales, data engineering/science, and consulting

If you're excited about the role but your experience, skills or qualifications don't perfectly align, we encourage you to apply anyway.

Additional Information

Our Values

  • METRICS DRIVEN . We use insights to improve our customers’ experience and our business performance
  • ACCOUNTABLE . We are accountable to ourselves and those we work with: we keep our promises and get things done
  • GROWTH MINDSET . This value enables us to be nimble to the changing realities and operate with a sense of urgency

  • CUSTOMER CENTRIC . We are customer‑centric in all that we do
  • COLLABORATIVE . We are collaborative, able to work across teams and capitalise on the diversity of intellect, perspectives, and experiences.

title: Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager
description:
Overview

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager is responsible for leading the venue branding, look and signage operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. This position is responsible for overseeing the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, ensuring that the look and feel is up to FIFA quality standards.

The role assumes event operational proficiency, venue dressing, signage and wayfinding knowledge with project management skills to directly overseeing the dressing implementation at four FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ stadia. They will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met within their sites and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations within their sites, ensuring that all are managed successfully and efficiently while monitoring budgetary spending within agreed limits. They will ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. The role will collaborate closely with other dressing, signage, wayfinding and non-competition managers to maximize creativity and ensure consistency across all stadiums.

Key Responsibilities

  • Overseeing the turnkey planning of dressing and signage implementation across all official sites during planning phase, and stadium dressing for 3-5 stadia closer to the tournament.
  • Collaborating with the other Stadium Dressing Managers and ensuring that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament stadiums.
  • Working closely with the Non-Competition Dressing Managers and the Wayfinding and Signage Managers as well as other Functional Area Managers, to maximize efficiencies across the wider project.
  • Being the focal point for all general stadium dressing questions or requests from the Head of Department.
  • Oversight of contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all stadiums within the assigned sites.
  • Constant monitoring of the budgetary impact of dressing operations and reporting updates to the Senior Manager and Head of Department regularly.
  • Providing strategic input into the stadium dressing planning process and offering expertise when required.
  • Adhering to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department.
  • Daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimized at all stages of the project.
  • Liaising with stadium owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans.
  • Presenting to senior team members, management and other FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ functional areas as and when required.
  • Attending department-specific and organization site visits at assigned stadiums and other stadiums or official sites.
  • Inputting into the site-specific dressing strategies utilizing expertise from previous events and directives from management.
  • Acting as the main stadium dressing point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers within the assigned sites during the implementation phase of the project.
  • Participating in the creative design process for stadiums within the assigned sites.
  • Assisting with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required.
  • Ensuring the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against within the assigned sites.
  • Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities.
  • Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months in to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods.

Your Profile

  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. or a minimum 2 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive dressing or signage related activities.
  • A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.).
  • Strong understanding of stadium look and feel requirements and large-scale temporary installations.
  • Budget management experience on complex and multi-faceted events and projects.
  • Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events.
  • Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events.
  • Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential.
  • The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on-site attendance during the tournament period.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

¡Work with purpose. Make your vision come true!

Health & Public Service (H&PS) within Accenture’s Strategy & Consulting practice partners with leading public‑sector institutions and healthcare organizations around the world to design and deliver high‑impact strategies that improve citizen services, modernize health ecosystems, and strengthen public‑sector performance. Our teams combine deep industry expertise with advanced digital, data, and GenAI capabilities to help governments, healthcare payers and providers, nonprofits, and education systems navigate complexity, transform their operating models, and drive measurable outcomes that improve lives and communities. As part of the Global Network, we bring globally scaled skills, innovative solutions, and collaborative ways of working to unlock 360° value for clients across all H&PS domains.

Grow your career and experience a stimulating, fast‑paced environment working with prestigious clients on diverse projects to solve significant business challenges. You will deliver lasting impact as you work as part of a highly specialized team, combining overseas client‑site work with opportunities based locally, and contribute to high performance through continuous collaboration and knowledge sharing.

HOW WILL YOUR EVERYDAY BE?

As a Business & Technology Integration Manager in the Health & Public Services (H&PS) sector, you will specialize in aligning cutting‑edge technology solutions with strategic business objectives to drive impactful transformation. This role bridges the gap between business needs and technological capabilities, ensuring seamless integration that enhances operational efficiency and service delivery.

Skills

  • Technology Strategy Development: Aligning tech solutions with business goals and creating strategic roadmaps.
  • Business Process Analysis: Optimizing workflows to enable effective tech integration.
  • Digital Transformation: Leveraging AI, cloud, and IoT to drive innovation.
  • Stakeholder Management: Collaborating across cross‑functional teams and clients to ensure alignment.
  • Data Analysis & Insights: Using data to inform decisions and improve outcomes.
  • Problem Solving & Analytical Thinking: Structuring issues and developing actionable insights.
  • Communication Skills: Aligning technical teams in strategic and business focus objectives.

Tools & Certifications

  • Agile & Scrum: Product Owner (PO), Product Manager, SaFe.
  • Project Management: Any project management or Program Management certification.
  • Power BI: Data visualization and analytics.
  • Six Sigma: Process improvement and quality control.
  • Capacity to plan, execute, and control the full lifecycle of an ERP implementation project (SAP, Oracle, Workday).
  • Software knowledge: Microsoft Project, Jira, Confluence, Azure environment, Git.

Frameworks

  • Strategic Analysis SDLC Excellence Standards, SWOT Analysis, Porter’s Five Forces, BCG Matrix, Operational Efficiency, Lean Methodology, Scrum and Kanban frameworks, Six Sigma, Clinical & Public Service Outcomes, Patient Journey Mapping, Clinical Pathway Development, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Financial & Governance, Integrated Business Planning, Value and Portfolio Analysis, Stakeholder Engagement Models.

Sample H&PS Specific Applications

  • Smart City Missions: Data integration across departments.
  • Digital Agriculture: Governance systems for decision‑making.
  • Education Reform: ERP integration across universities.
  • Healthcare Strategy: Clinical value targeting and provider growth acceleration.

  • Internet reimbursement.
  • 100% covered gym membership.
  • Flexible vacations.

  • Sponsored certifications.

  • Performance bonuses.
  • Accenture Days.
  • Flexible benefits package.
  • Extended maternity and paternity leave.
  • Childcare financial assistance.
  • …and many more.

We have offices in CABA, Córdoba, Mendoza, Salta, Mar del Plata and Rosario!

Remote Work

We also have several positions that are 100% remote, so you can join us working from home!

Professional Growth

We want you to get the tools you need to keep learning, growing, and making a difference in the world. We have areas of value for your growth, both professionally and personally. You can access exclusive courses and certifications.

At Accenture, Equality Drives Innovation

Did you know that Accenture was voted the most diverse and inclusive company in the world? We believe that the workforce of the future is an equal force for all.

title: Full Stack Engineer ID48139
description:
Overview

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US: If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

About the role

As a Tech Lead Full Stack Engineer, you will shape the technical direction of a consumer-facing platform, ensuring it scales reliably as the product and community grow. This role combines hands-on development with technical leadership, influencing architecture, quality, and cross-functional collaboration. You’ll own critical systems, mentor a growing team, and modernize a complex codebase. It’s a high-impact opportunity in a fast-paced, product-led environment.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and code robust, scalable features across frontend and backend;
  • Work deeply in an existing web application codebase, enhancing core modules and integrating with a graph database;
  • Implement state management with Redux and design performant React components;
  • Manage a small but growing team of developers;
  • Divide tasks and assign them to individuals;
  • Review code;
  • Collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering teams by communicating progress and blockers early and often;
  • Maintain high standards for documentation, testing, and code reviews;
  • Architect solutions that handle high throughput while maintaining low latency;
  • Lead technical initiatives to reduce manual operations and improve system reliability.

MUST HAVES

  • 7+ years of full-stack development experience ;
  • 3+ years of team lead or management experience ;
  • Proven track record of mentoring other engineers and driving technical initiatives;
  • Experience with graph databases (Neptune with Gremlin preferred) ;
  • Experience with web and mobile application technologies including HTML/CSS, React, React Native, TypeScript, Tailwind, Redux, Node.js, and Next.js ;
  • Experience using Git ;
  • Proven ability to navigate and improve large, production-scale codebases ;
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills in a fast-moving team environment;
  • Strong track record of delivering solutions with high throughput and low latency requirements ;
  • Upper-intermediate English level .

NICE TO HAVES

  • Familiarity with cloud deployments and CI/CD pipelines;
  • Experience optimizing large-scale frontends for performance and accessibility;
  • Experience with AI frameworks or SDKs;
  • Start-up mindset and comfort with trying new approaches and tackling new challenges.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
  • Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.
  • Flextime: Flexible schedule with remote and office options.

Preferred Qualifications

description:
ENGENHEIRO DE SEGURANÇA DO TRABALHO PJ - Sorocaba/SP e Região

Já pensou em fazer parte de uma empresa suíça, e de fazer parte de um time com mais de 90 mil colaboradores no mundo?

Junte-se a uma equipe reconhecida por sua excelência, inovação, integridade, colaboração, segurança e espírito empreendedor.

No Brasil, são 6 linhas de negócios. Business Assurance, Health & Nutrition, Connectivity & Products, Natural Resources, Industries & Environment and Education.

Responsabilidades

  • Responsável pelo planejamento, coordenação e implementação de sistemas, políticas e programas de gestão de saúde e segurança ocupacional, garantindo a eliminação ou redução de riscos nos ambientes de trabalho e assegurando a conformidade legal da empresa. Atuando de forma estratégica nos planos de segurança específicos para obras de pavimentação, sinalização, intervenções emergenciais em rodovias, e outras atividades relacionadas, visando a prevenção de acidentes a minimização de riscos e a prevenção de impactos ambientais. Suas principais responsabilidades incluem a análise e mitigação de riscos em atividades críticas, como operações em rodovias com tráfego ativo, e a definição de estratégias para garantir a integridade física dos colaboradores, usuários e terceiros;
  • Elaborar e manter atualizadas planilhas com estatísticas de acidentes de trabalho, encaminhando relatórios periódicos para órgãos fiscalizadores e áreas de controle de sustentabilidade;
  • Analisar demandas de órgãos reguladores e públicos externos, garantindo o envio de informações no formato exigido;
  • Fiscalizar irregularidades de Qualidade, Segurança, Saúde, Meio Ambiente e Compliance (QSSMA) em vistorias de campo. Assegurar a aderência aos requisitos legais, regulamentares e normas internas da empresa;
  • Elaborar relatórios e registros fotográficos detalhados, encaminhando-os ao gestor imediato e ao gestor responsável pela área. Garantir a execução das atividades em alinhamento com as Regras de Ouro do Grupo CCR e normas de QSSMA, promovendo comportamentos seguros e prevenindo;
  • Atualizar e monitorar informações em sistemas operacionais específicos, incluindo CAT, PPRA, controle de extintores, EPI/EPC, brigadas de incêndio, CIPA, e relatórios periódicos;
  • Supervisionar a manutenção e disponibilidade de dispositivos de combate a incêndio, como extintores, hidrantes e alarmes, em conformidade com normas regulamentares. Supervisionar empresas terceirizadas em obras, verificando o cumprimento das normas de segurança, uso de EPIs/EPCs, e dispositivos de segurança coletiva;
  • Elaborar, revisar e implementar anualmente o PPRA - Programa de Prevenção de Riscos Ambientais, incluindo medições de riscos e propostas de soluções para mitigação;
  • Realizar investigações de acidentes, identificar causas-raiz e propor ações corretivas e preventivas. Acompanhar perícias judiciais relacionadas a acidentes de trabalho, em alinhamento com a área jurídica. Promover o Índice de Prática Segura (IPS) e ações de melhoria contínua com base em desvios identificados;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de treinamento e conscientização de segurança para equipes internas e contratadas. Contribuir para a gestão sustentável de resíduos no local de trabalho, conforme os aspectos e impactos ambientais da unidade. Monitorar e avaliar o impacto ambiental de obras em conformidade com os padrões internos e normativos.

Qualificações

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia com Especialização em Segurança do Trabalho;
  • 6 meses de experiência no cargo;
  • Experiência comprovada em obras rodoviárias ou contratos de concessão;
  • Pacote Office avançado.

Condições de contratação

  • Modelo de contratação PJ;
  • Residir na região de Porangaba, Boituva, Tatuí e Sorocaba;

Procuramos pessoas como você. Pessoas que vão abraçar a jornada na SGS com a mesma intensidade e paixão que nós fazemos! E aí? Topa desenvolver conexões mais fortes, seguras e mais eficientes na conosco?

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring an Engineering Manager as we expand the MAAS team. Our mission with MAAS ("Metal as a Service") is to provide the best solution for building and running private bare-metal infrastructure, putting a cloud-style on-demand API in front of physical server provisioning, network configuration, and storage. We're hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality software development and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux on physical servers, Linux storage and data center networking capabilities.
The Canonical MAAS team is responsible for delivering our Metal As A Service (MAAS) hyperscale provisioning technology. Ubuntu strives to be the most scalable, cloud ready server distribution and MAAS is our platform to get Ubuntu on bare metal servers. MAAS is a rapidly evolving software stack written in Python and Go. Its components span the entire software stack: from low-level hardware detection and provisioning, to the upper level management web interface, API, and CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.
Canonical is seeking passionate technical leaders who are eager to drive innovation in one of Canonical's flagship data center products. You will play a key role in reshaping the future of data center technology through open source management platforms. MAAS aims to revolutionize data center management at scale starting from day zero deployment to long term data center expansion and maintenance.
Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence team and company culture, facilitate technical delivery, and guide strategy and execution. In addition to these responsibilities, you will be expected to collaborate across engineering. The MAAS team regularly interfaces with teams responsible for cloud-init, LXD, and our public cloud offerings.
The successful candidate will have technical leadership attributes and can demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems.
Location : This is a work-from-anywhere position available in EMEA or the Americas.
The role entails

  • Leading a distributed team of engineers in your time zone (we organise engineering teams by Americas, EMEA etc)
  • Talent development through coaching, mentoring, feedback and career planning
  • Setting and managing expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Being an advocate of, and advancing, modern software development practices
  • Participating in the engineering process through code and architectural review
  • Engaging with broader teams at Canonical, the open source community and partners
  • Travelling to internal and external global events for 4 to 6 weeks per year
What we are looking for in you
  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) and a background in Computer Science
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Proven experience delivering software using Python, Golang, or similar languages
  • Experience with Linux system administration (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Familiarity with modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8S
  • Technical aptitude for understanding complex distributed systems
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with agile software development methodologies
  • Ability to mentor, develop, and support team members
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
Nice-to-have skills
  • Typescript using modern web frameworks such as React, Angular, Svelte or Vue
  • Data Center infrastructure management and design
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Credit Risk Lead role at R2 .

At R2, we believe that small and medium businesses are the productive engine of society. Small and medium businesses (SMBs) make up over 90% of companies in Latin America, yet they face a trillion-dollar credit gap. Our mission is to unlock SMBs’ potential by providing financial solutions that are tailored to their needs. We are reimagining the financial infrastructure of Latin America - where SMBs financial needs are satisfied without ever having to go to a bank. R2 enables platforms in Latin America to embed financial services that SMBs can then leverage (starting with revenue-based financing). We are a tight knit team coming from organizations such as Amazon, Google, Nubank, Capital One, Uber, Mercado Libre, Globant, J.P. Morgan and HSBC. We are backed by world-class investors such as Gradient Ventures (Google’s AI-focused fund), COMETA, General Catalyst, Hi Ventures, Y Combinator, Femsa Ventures, Prosus, Endeavor Catalyst, among others.

We are seeking a highly skilled and innovative Credit Risk Lead to drive decision-making processes and optimize credit portfolio performance. The ideal candidate will combine expertise in data analysis, machine learning, and statistical modeling to enhance risk assessment, develop actionable insights, and improve operational efficiency. This role offers the opportunity to collaborate cross-functionally and influence strategic decisions at the core of our credit risk infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Data Analysis
    • Analyze large, complex datasets to uncover trends, patterns, and correlations that influence credit risk and financial performance.
    • Provide actionable insights to key stakeholders to improve risk management strategies.
    • Provide actionable insights that can be reflected in Credit Policy
  • Machine Learning & AI
    • Develop and enhance predictive models using machine learning techniques to assess and mitigate credit risk.
    • Optimize algorithms to improve model performance and reduce risk exposure.
  • Portfolio Risk Assessment
    • Collaborate with the risk management team to evaluate the risk profile of the credit portfolio.
    • Forecast future risk trends and recommend data-driven mitigation strategies.
  • A/B Testing
    • Design and conduct A/B tests to evaluate the impact of new features on risk performance and adoption metrics.
  • Reporting & Visualization
    • Prepare comprehensive reports, dashboards, and presentations to communicate findings and recommendations to executives, regulators, and other stakeholders.
  • Process Improvement
    • Identify opportunities to streamline operational processes and enhance decision-making frameworks.
  • Collaboration
    • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including credit risk, finance, and IT, to integrate models and data seamlessly into the organization’s risk infrastructure.

Requirements

  • Experience in developing and implementing machine learning models for risk assessment.
  • Programming languages such as Python, R, or similar.
  • Advanced SQL skills for querying and manipulating large datasets.
  • Strong statistical thinking and the ability to translate data into actionable business insights.
  • Experience in designing and analyzing A/B tests to inform strategic decisions.
  • Excellent communication skills for presenting complex information to diverse audiences.
  • Ability to work in a collaborative, fast-paced environment with a focus on innovation and results.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with lending business and frameworks in credit risk management.
  • Knowledge of visualization tools

title: Coordenador(a) Facilities - Fábrica
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Objetivo do Cargo

Coordenar o time de analistas e os prestadores de serviços de Facilities da Fábrica, tais como, Portarias/acessos, Transporte dos colaboradores, Gestão de Frota, Segurança Patrimonial, Limpeza Convencional e Restaurante Industrial, definindo metas e indicadores, delegando responsabilidades, elaborando e aprovando planejamento e orçamento anual/mensal, garantindo a segurança das pessoas, otimizando recursos, custos e assegurando a eficiência dos serviços prestados.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Implantação da Área de Facilities da Fábrica:
  • Coordenar os processos de Facilities: Portarias/acessos, Transporte dos colaboradores, Gestão de Frota, Segurança Patrimonial e Limpeza convencional, Jardinagem, e Restaurante Industrial, assegurando o correto dimensionamento e direcionamento dos recursos, avaliando os prestadores de serviço e realizando os ajustes necessários, garantindo a segurança do time e custos adequados;

Local:

Inocência - Mato Grosso do Sul – Brasil

Requisitos do Cargo:

  • Formação: Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Facilities, Finanças, Logística ou Gestão de Projetos.
  • Experiência: Sólida vivência em posições de liderança em Facilities, preferencialmente em indústrias de base e projetos greenfield.

Com uma cultura marcante guiada por quatro valores - Sonho Grande, Espírito Empreendedor, Foco no Cliente e Mente Aberta - a XP Inc. está sempre em busca dos melhores talentos que tem ambição de fazer o impossível.

title: Dam Safety Engineer/ Subject Matter Expert
description:
Dam Safety Engineer/ Subject Matter Expert

Join to apply for the Dam Safety Engineer/ Subject Matter Expert role at HDR .

Overview

HDR is looking for Professional Engineers for various disciplines and in multiple locations across the country to join our Hydropower Practice. HDR is a hydropower and dam safety industry leader. We are experts in FERC Part 12 Dam Safety Program, and we perform FERC Comprehensive Assessments (CAs) and Periodic Inspections (PIs). HDR seeks Subject Matter Experts in Civil, Hydraulics/Hydrology, Structural, Geotechnical, Geological, and Mechanical engineering. Our national Hydropower Practice provides mechanical, electrical, structural, geotechnical and site civil engineering expertise, along with environmental scientists and regulatory specialists. Hydropower is a critical and renewable component of the US energy portfolio, and our team supports hydropower owners across the US and Canada. If you are looking for a dynamic work environment with career growth opportunities and the chance to work on innovative hydropower, pumped-storage and dam safety projects, we welcome the opportunity to speak with you.

Hybrid or flexible work locations are available across the country.

Primary duties

  • Support inspections and engineering assessments of existing dams and water-retaining structures.
  • Conduct analyses, evaluations and designs; develop design options or recommendations with supporting calculations.
  • Prepare contract documents including drawings, specifications, design documentation and criteria, and cost estimates for various new and/or rehabilitation of hydraulic structures, including dams, spillways, gates, outlet works, diversion structures, retaining walls, floodwalls, water conveyance structures, foundations, etc.
  • Perform engineering assignments that may require critical thinking and creativity to address unique elements with limited or no specific code-based guidance.
  • Work with multi-disciplinary teams on a variety of hydropower, pumped storage and dam safety engineering projects.
  • Work independently as project engineer and provide oversight, QA/QC and mentorship of staff as needed.
  • Participate in risk assessments for dams and hydraulic structures.
  • Some travel is required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Civil, Structural, Mechanical, Geotechnical, Geological, or Geotechnical engineering (or related engineering degree).
  • Minimum of 8 years of professional experience in one of the following disciplines: Geotechnical, Geological, Civil/Structural or Hydrology and Hydraulics, or Mechanical engineering or life safety and economic consequence estimation.
  • Experience with dams, water conveyances or other constructed project works and infrastructure associated with hydropower and pumped-storage projects regulated by FERC or other agencies.
  • Experience working in a multi-disciplinary environment.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office, Excel and Word, AutoCAD and/or MicroStation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Self-motivated, able to work independently and with a project team to completion of task.
  • An attitude and commitment to quality, teaming, innovative problem solving, communication, relationship management, and the culture that is integral to our employee ownership model.
  • Ability to travel as needed for inspections, meetings or other requirements.
  • Experience specific to the hydropower industry, including one or more of:
    • Experience with the FERC dam safety regulatory process including preparation of DSSMPs, DSSMRs, STIDs, and participation in Part 12D dam safety inspections.
    • FERC dam safety assessment, analysis, and design experience.
    • Hydropower design experience relative to dams, penstocks, intakes, powerhouses, and/or retaining structures in and around hydropower facilities.
    • FERC SQRA facilitation training and experience.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering.
  • 7 years related experience.
  • A minimum 2 years project management experience.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license.
  • MS Office and MS Project experience is required (Access experience would be a plus).
  • Demonstrated leadership skills.
  • An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee-owned culture is a must.

What We Believe

HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.

Our Commitment

As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day.

Employee Network Groups

Eight groups, including Asian Pacific, Black, Hispanic/Latino(a), LGBTQ+, People with Disabilities, Veterans, Women, and Young Professionals, help create a sense of belonging. Each group has an executive sponsor and is open to all employees.

Benefits and compensation

Benefits include medical, dental, vision, short- and long-term disability, life insurance, an employee assistance program, paid time away, parental leave, paid holidays, a retirement savings plan with employer match, employee referral bonus and tuition reimbursement. title: Sales Engineering Delivery Manager (Middle/Senior) ID39657
description:
Sales Engineering Delivery Manager (Middle/Senior) ID39657

Overview

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

About the role: As a Sales Engineering Delivery Manager, you will serve as the crucial link between our prospective clients and internal teams. In this role, you will lead technical discovery sessions and consultative introduction calls, gather essential engagement details (such as timelines, budgets, skillset requirements, risks, and SWOT analyses), and translate these insights into impactful proposals. This position requires a strong grasp of both business strategy and the software development lifecycle (SDLC), along with outstanding communication and design skills to create engaging, high-quality deliverables.

What you will do

  • Technical Discovery Call & Stakeholder Engagement: Assemble Sales Support Engineering team, align them on preliminary information, following internal RACI procedures; Lead the Technical Discovery call, showcasing outstanding interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport and trust quickly; Demonstrate in-depth knowledge of the SDLC—from ideation and inception, through discovery and development, to market release—to guide discussions and identify project feasibility; Use consultative questioning techniques to uncover client pain points and business objectives, extracting and analyzing high-level requirements such as project timeline, budget constraints, technical skill requirements, and risk assessments; Showcase strong presentation and storytelling skills, ensuring clarity and persuasion in all client-facing interactions, both during calls and via emails.
  • Proposal Development & Deliverable Creation: Develop dynamic, visually compelling presentation decks and engagement proposals that clearly articulate service offerings, project scope, value propositions, and strategic recommendations; Customize deliverables to reflect client-specific challenges and opportunities uncovered during discovery meetings; Integrate technical insights with business strategy, ensuring that proposals account for both immediate deliverables and long-term client growth.
  • Team Buildout and Project Kickoff: Act as the primary point of coordination among Sales, Recruiting, and Engineering teams, ensuring smooth hand-offs from initial engagement through team buildout to project kick-off; Serve as a “concierge” for deals, maintaining fluid communication and alignment across functions to drive successful client onboarding; Serve as a trusted advisor during pre-sales engagements by translating complex technical aspects into digestible, business-focused narratives; Maintain a sales/consulting mindset throughout the technical discovery process, ensuring proposals align with targeted business outcomes.

MUST HAVES

  • Exceptional Communication & Soft Skills: outstanding interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport and trust quickly; strong presentation and storytelling skills, ensuring clarity and persuasion in all client-facing interactions.
  • UX & Presentation Design Acumen: solid grasp of user experience (UX) principles and design thinking, enabling effective discussion of digital product experiences; proven track record of creating high-quality, visually engaging presentation decks and proposals.
  • Technical Savvy & SDLC Knowledge: a deep understanding of the software development lifecycle—from conceptualization through to market release—and familiarity with agile methodologies; capability to discuss technical nuances without losing sight of the business impact, bridging the gap between technical details and strategic outcomes.
  • Analytical & Strategic Thinking: strong analytical skills to synthesize complex information, identify key insights, and recommend actionable strategies; ability to prioritize client objectives while balancing technical feasibility and business goals.
  • Team Collaboration & Cross-Functional Coordination: demonstrated ability to work effectively across multiple departments, managing internal communications as deals move from the funnel stage to the kickoff; capability to serve as a liaison, ensuring alignment and clarity among Sales, Engineering, and Recruiting teams.
  • Consultative Sales Experience: prior experience in a pre-sales, sales engineering, or technical consulting role, ideally within a digital software consultancy or similar environment; ability to quickly assess client needs and transform them into actionable insights and proposals.
  • English: Upper Intermediate English level.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
  • A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
  • Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
description:
Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Engineering at TRACTIAN

The Backend Engineering team plays a critical role in building and scaling the infrastructure that powers our entire platform: from our advanced monitoring products to our CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System). We design and develop robust systems that handle large volumes of real-time and historical data from industrial assets.

Our team is responsible for crafting and maintaining data-intensive microservices, resilient APIs, and scalable ETL pipelines. We work across multiple domains: from designing relational and non-relational database schemas to implementing event-driven architectures and optimizing performance under high-throughput workloads.

As part of a product-led company, Backend Engineers at TRACTIAN operate with strong ownership. We collaborate closely with firmware, frontend, data, and product teams to deliver high-impact features that directly improve equipment reliability, reduce downtime, and modernize industrial operations.

What you'll do

As a Backend Software Engineer at our company, you will design and build critical APIs, microservices, and ETLs that power our core products, from industrial monitoring systems to our CMMS platform. You’ll play a key role in evolving our backend architecture to meet the demands of scale, performance, and product excellence. Your work will directly impact thousands of users across industries that rely on us to keep their operations running.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain data-intensive, high-performance backend services based on an event-driven architecture.
  • Develop and maintain APIs and services that power both real-time monitoring features and complex maintenance workflows.
  • Work closely with a cross-functional team to ensure our backend applications align with the overall product vision and user experience goals.
  • Optimize applications and data processing workflows for performance, focusing on enhancing speed, efficiency, and reliability across various operating environments.
  • Continuously evolve our systems through refactoring, introducing best practices, and improving maintainability and observability.
  • Document architectural decisions and technical implementations clearly for the team and future maintainers.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years of backend development experience, with a strong focus on developing user-facing products.
  • Solid experience in event-driven applications using messaging technologies like Kafka, RabbitMQ, BullMQ, or similar.
  • Strong programming skills in Go, Python, Node.js, and/or Rust.
  • Deep understanding of microservices architecture and distributed system design.
  • Proficiency in both relational (e.g., PostgreSQL, ClickHouse) and non-relational databases (e.g., ScyllaDB, Cassandra, MongoDB), with a focus on performance and scalability.
  • Experience building mission-critical backend services in high-growth, product-driven environments.

Bonus points

  • Contributions to open-source or personal projects demonstrating backend architecture or data processing expertise.
  • Fluency in English.

Compensation:

  • Competitive salary and stock options.
  • Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses.
  • 30 days of paid annual leave.
  • Education and courses stipend.
  • Employee Giving.
  • Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years.
  • Up to R$1.000/mo for meals and remote work allowance.
  • Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation.
  • Dental Insurance: we help you with dental treatment for a better quality of life.
  • Gympass and Sports Incentive: R$300/mo extra if you practice activities.

title: Integration Manager
description:
About The Company

If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey. We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay). To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more. Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

The Team/role

The Integration Manager acts as the key bridge between business and technical teams, leading the design and governance of system integrations that enable seamless collaboration between merchants, partners, and internal platforms. This role ensures technical scalability, commercial alignment, and cross‑functional coordination to deliver integrations that create measurable business impact.

In this role, you'll be...

  • Lead the planning, coordination, and implementation of complex system integrations between internal platforms and external partners.
  • Work closely with Sales, Product, Tech, and Operations to prioritize integration pipelines and ensure alignment with commercial goals.
  • Define integration standards, documentation, and best practices to ensure scalability and reliability.
  • Evaluate new partners’ technical feasibility, design integration architecture, and support business case validation.
  • Supervise and mentor Integration Analysts (D5/D6), ensuring timely execution and adherence to SLAs.
  • Manage technical governance of integrations, including change control, versioning, and communication with stakeholders.
  • Track and report integration performance metrics (stability, response times, coverage, and partner satisfaction).
  • Act as the primary liaison with global Product and R&D teams, aligning local needs with system capabilities and roadmap.
  • Identify opportunities to optimize existing integrations and support scalable productization of custom solutions.

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

  • 5+ years of experience in system integration, solution engineering, or technical project management.
  • Strong understanding of API ecosystems (REST, Webhooks, OAuth2, JSON/XML) and integration frameworks.
  • Proven experience managing cross‑functional projects with business and technical stakeholders.
  • Strategic and analytical mindset, able to connect technical design with business outcomes.
  • Experience in e‑commerce, marketplace, or SaaS environments is highly desirable.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder‑management skills, including with global teams.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English; Mandarin is a strong plus.
  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or Business Administration (post‑graduate studies preferred).
  • Hands‑on familiarity with CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot), ERPs, or e‑commerce systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach and coordinate technical contributors while maintaining strong delivery focus.

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value. We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data‑driven. We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data‑driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win‑win Collaboration. Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity. Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth. We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion. Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non‑negotiable value of who we are. We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. And we count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. This part of our journey has been written, there remains a long road before us. We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).
